definition: A worksheet for reporting sales and exchanges of capital assets, reconciling amounts reported on information returns with amounts reported on the taxpayer's return, and allowing adjustments to basis and gain or loss calculations.

includes.text: Form used to report sales and exchanges of capital assets with reconciliation to information returns
includes.quote: Use Form 8949 to report sales and exchanges of capital assets

includes.text: Separates transactions by holding period into short-term and long-term capital gains and losses
includes.quote: Report short-term gains and losses on Part I. Report long-term gains and losses on Part II

includes.text: Contains columns for description, dates, proceeds, basis, adjustments, and gain or loss
Includes provisions for reporting digital asset transactions separately from traditional securities
includes.quote: Digital asset transactions should not be reported using box C or F. Instead, digital asset transactions should be reported using box G, H, or I for short-term transactions

excludes.text: Does not report overall capital gains and losses summary or capital loss carryovers
excludes.quote: To figure the overall gain (or loss) from transactions reported on Form 8949

excludes.text: Does not report gains from business property sales or involuntary conversions from casualty or theft
excludes.quote: To report a gain from Form 6252 or Part I of Form 4797

excludes.text: Does not report the corporation's total income and tax liability
excludes.quote: Corporations and partnerships use Form 8949 to report

discriminators.text: This form reports individual transactions with detailed columns for each sale; the sibling summarizes overall capital gains and losses by type and holding period
discriminators.quote: Enter all sales and exchanges of capital assets

discriminators.text: This form reports capital asset sales including stocks, bonds, and real estate held for investment; the sibling reports sales of business property and depreciable assets used in trade or business
discriminators.quote: Enter all sales and exchanges of capital assets, including stocks, bonds, digital assets, and real estate

discriminators.text: This form is filed by individuals, partnerships, estates, and trusts to report capital asset transactions; the sibling is a corporation income tax return reporting total corporate income and tax
discriminators.quote: Individuals. Individuals use Form 8949 to report
